signup_race.description: Duplicate account creation via race condition

websocket_race.description: Race condition over WebSocket messages. Rapid burst of WS frames within a tight time window bypasses sequential checks (balance, inventory, coupon redemption). Unlike HTTP race conditions, WS races exploit message-ordering assumptions in event-loop processing. LYKNCTF 2026 Spawn Race pattern.

probes.description: Detection: send N identical WS messages in rapid succession (test_websocket_injection + concurrent). If the server processes duplicates, the sequential assumption is broken.
